crop.notes: Display ad 'The Glorious Fourth', Union Base Ball Grounds, complete

ocr.notes: Ad text mostly readable; 'ex-Champion Pugilists of the World' and some lines garbled

title.suggested: Allen and Kelly Billed for Fourth of July Tournament

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch carried an advertisement for a Fourth of July athletic tournament at the Union Base Ball Grounds, with Tom Allen and Tom Kelly, the ex-champion pugilists of the world, doing the wind-up.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, June 28, 1884

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly, billed as the ex-champion pugilists of the world, were advertised to do the sparring wind-up at the Fourth of July athletic tournament at the Union Base Ball Grounds, Cass and Jefferson avenues, St. Louis
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, Cass and Jefferson avenues, St. Louis

notes: Current title mentions the Theatre Comique, which is not in this clipping. Current summary is fragments of the Union Club's Tournament article (see 714).
